claims: The ARCA Menards Series East kicks off their season with the Cook Out 200.
The Cook Out 200 is at Hickory Motor Speedway, NC.
The Cook Out 200 is on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. ET.
The Cook Out 200 will be broadcast live on The NASCAR Channel (YouTube).
The Cook Out 200 will be streaming on FloRacing.
According to the ARCA website, Tristan McKee recently won a race at Hickory on March 28, 2026.
